author: claude-opus-5-5

objective.text: Orders brought to ready (6/6) per dollar: recovery and YES claims filed canonically, undecided orders ready after owner adoption of upheld proposals. Spend is a limit, not a goal.

configuration.lifecycle_review: two fresh blind claude-opus-5-5 arms per batch, one planted control, both-uphold rule
configuration.recovery_route: Cujas/Haloander h01 route (producer word-by-word comparison against the held official printing, two blind arms)

sequence: 1. Recovery lane: the 6 custody-stranded and 26 working-text-stale orders (Bentham ranks 7-8), batches of up to 26.

2. YES lane: the Larrey-admitted members of production.claim_ready.yes.fr, all previously worked by Papinian on 2026-11-10 and blocked mainly by NEA continuation notices (now held: theophilus-sources, 673 notices) and EO 13286 (now held: fr-originals 68 FR 10619). First batch of 25 is a checkpoint: continue only if 4 or more are filed.

3. Undecided lane: first batch is the Lind stage-0 draw exactly (research/lind/stage0/draw.py, 15 all-gates + 15 hard-only, seed 20261112). Continue only under the Lind 7.3 decision rules (success: a >= 3 and all-gates dollars per ready <= 9.30); continuation batches of 30 drawn at random from the all-gates pool (1 in 5 from hard-only if soft gates hold).
4. Every batch runs under bentham.py gate; STOP ends the action. Completions run one at a time.

premortem.failure: YES re-run repeats Papinian's failures because the new sources are not in the claim-kit build
premortem.guard: Before the YES batch, confirm one blocked order's packet now carries the theophilus notice or EO 13286 record; 25-order checkpoint stops the lane below 4 filed

premortem.failure: Undecided yield stays at the old 3-10% and money goes to failed dispatches
premortem.guard: Lind stage-0 decision rules gate any continuation; dispatch-check before every producer; blocked orders recorded, not retried

premortem.failure: Coordinator context grows and dominates cost, as in Haloander
premortem.guard: Scripts from the Papinian and Cujas tools do clerical work; stop a lane if coordinator dollars exceed 0.25 per attempt after 10 orders

premortem.failure: A review error is read as yield
premortem.guard: Planted control per review set, two fresh blind Opus arms, both-uphold rule; any missed control stops the lane for adjudication

premortem.failure: Concurrent completions corrupt each other's receipts
premortem.guard: Completions strictly serial; merge main into the production tree only between batches

premortem.failure: Disk fills (1.5 GB free) and a completion fails midway
premortem.guard: Completion receipts gzipped as Papinian did; temporary packets outside git removed after each batch
